actions_english.prompt:
Respond with detailed but simple instructions in English. Each line must consists of only one action, where the mentioned objects must be items from the following list: ['chicken leg', 'cabinet right door', 'cabinet left door', 'cabinet', 'stove on the left', 'stove on the right', 'counter top on the left', 'counter top on the right', 'pot lid', 'pot body', 'pot bottom', 'stove knob on the right', 'stove knob on the left', 'kitchen sink', 'faucet handle', 'fridge', 'fridge door', 'fridge shelf', 'salt shaker', 'pepper shaker'].

    Currently, you can see the following objects: ``the pot lid is in the stove on the left,
the pot body is on the counter top on the right,
the chicken leg is on the fridge shelf,
the salt shaker is in the cabinet,
the pepper shaker is in the cabinet,
cabinet right door is partially open,
cabinet left door is partially open,
fridge door is partially open,
stove knob on the right is turned off,
stove knob on the left is turned off,
faucet handle is turned off''
Use the following contexts for creating your action sequence:
How to Make Chicken Soup
There's plenty enough chicken flavor in this soup to add it and not alter the taste.
Authors Note: You can add croutons to the side or crisp your bread in the oven if anyone's suffering from a scratchy throat.
Serve soup in a bowl with a handle so it can be eaten while in bed.
Also, serve with any absorbent bread of your choosing.
Enjoy!
NOTE RE AMT:.
Makes approx 2-1/2 cups of "condensed" cream of chicken soup, which will work for most recipes calling for canned soup.
Place the chicken in the water, bring to a boil and immediately lower to simmer.
Add the carrot, onion and celery.
Simmer for 1 hour.
Carefully remove the vegetables and chicken from the broth.
Place the vegetables in a food processor, remove the meat (not fat) from the bones, and place the meat in the food processor as well.
